name: list_events
description: List events from Google Calendar. Starts from now by default; use time_min/time_max to look at a specific period and query to search by text.

max_results.description: Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 10 if not provided.

time_min.description: Optional start of the time range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp with timezone (e.g. 2025-06-15T00:00:00Z). Only events ending after this time are returned. Defaults to now if not provided.

time_max.description: Optional end of the time range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp with timezone (e.g. 2025-06-22T00:00:00Z). Only events starting before this time are returned. No upper limit if not provided.

query.description: Optional free-text search. Only events matching the text (in title, description, location, attendees, etc.) are returned.

calendar_id.description: Optional ID of the calendar to use. Usually a person's email address (for a shared or colleague calendar). Use list_calendars to see the available calendar IDs. Defaults to the configured calendar if not provided.
